strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Enhancing manufacturing capabilities, increasing backward integration and expanding capacity to meet customer requirements
- Built ODM capability in air conditioners: developed R&D capabilities and launched an own ODM AC lineup
- Broadening product variety and segments in commercial refrigeration and other refrigeration products
- Localising compressor production: started local manufacturing of compressors
- Growing in-house component manufacturing, where investments have begun to break even and contribute
- Adding customers and building presence outside Nashik, in Chennai and Sanand
